reuse.why: Extends the existing isMonthFillCategory predicate, which already decides month-fill eligibility for all actions, and reuses the shared extractTagsFromText parser.

duplication.why: The tag rule exists once, but the notes LEFT JOIN and group_notes field are added to two separate queries (getBudgetData and getMonthFillCategories) that feed the predicate.

placement.why: The rule lives in the shared month-fill predicate in budget/actions.ts alongside the hidden and template rules.

scope.why: Only the predicate, its two data queries and tests are touched.

maintainability.why: Centralised decision with a clear comment; a maintainer must remember to keep both feeding queries selecting group_notes.

one_place.where: isMonthFillCategory in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, used by copyPreviousMonth and via getMonthFillCategories by the other month-wide actions
